item.title: This is quite a house! Mid-Century Modern in Oregon. C. 1951. $5,195,000
item.description: This is quite a house! This mid-century modern house was designed by John Yeon. It is known as the Shaw House. Would be the perfect house for entertaining. The Shaw House was built in 1951. It is located on .61 acre in Lake Oswego, Oregon. The house features a wine cellar, media room, large patio, three outdoor fireplaces, pool, pool house and views of Mt. Hood. Four bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,768 square feet. $5,195,000 From the Zillow listing: THE SHAW HOUSE-John Yeon designed true Mid Cen

item.title: Stone cottage with a pool! Circa 1940 in Pennsylvania. $169,900
item.description: Love stone houses! This has a lot of potential! And the pool was a nice surprise! The house was built in 1940. It is located on .48 acre in Uniontown, Pennsylvania. The house features a stone exterior, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding and french doors. There is a large deck, patio and an in-ground pool. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,581 square feet. $169,900 Contact Paul Bortz with Coldwell Banker Laurel Ridge Realty: 724-437-7100 From the Zillow listing: This Step into timeless cha

item.title: Porch goals! Circa 1928 in South Carolina. $275,000
item.description: Porch goals! Can picture myself sitting there and reading a good book! The house was built in 1928. It is located on .55 acre in Edgefield, South Carolina. The house features a wrap around front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, crown moulding, fretwork, spacious kitchen, bead board and transom window. There is a carport and a detached storage shed. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,564 square feet. $275,000 Contact Amanda T. Israel with Amanda Real Estate Group: 803-292-5202 From the Zillow li

item.title: Look at that upper porch! Circa 1900 in Texas. $355,900
item.description: Check out that upper porch! This house has nice details! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .4 acre in Hubbard, Texas. The house features a large wrap around front porch, upper porch, screened in porch, wrought iron fencing, wood floors, pocket doors, crown moulding, transom windows, claw foot tub and a lot of kitchen cabinets. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,022 square feet. $355,900 Contact Bailee Garrett with Real Broker: 855-450-0442 From the Zillow listing: A rare historic Vi

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Circa 1870 in Vermont. $69,900
item.description: Definitely a fixer upper! But there is some potential there. The porch is interesting. The house was built in 1870. It is located on .51 acre in Richford, Vermont. The house features a small covered porch, a covered back porch, spacious kitchen, claw foot tub and an enclosed back porch. The house isn’t far from Jay Peak Four Season Resort. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,292 square feet. $69,900 Contact Jennifer Mahoney with Vermont Mountain Real Estate: 802-323-4383 From the Zillow listing:

item.title: Cute house! Circa 1929 in West Virginia. $134,500
item.description: This is a cute house! It’s been updated. The listing says 70 acres, but I believe they must mean .70. The house was built in 1929. It is located in Bluefield, West Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, pretty wood floors, arched entryway, wide baseboards, brick fireplace, nice staircase and an updated kitchen. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 896 square feet. $134,500 Contact Maranda Bolin with Christian Management Corp From the Zillow listing: Completely remodeled and move-in ready!

item.title: Pretty! The Martin K. Dahl House, Circa 1879 in Wisconsin. $349,900
item.description: I love Second Empire style houses! This one has pretty details! It is known as the Martin K. Dahl House. It was built in 1879. It is located on .52 acre in Waupun, Wisconsin. The house features double front doors, wood floors, wainscoting, crown moulding, wide baseboards, picture rails and crystal chandeliers. There is a detached carriage house on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,430 square feet. $349,900 Contact Greg Holz: 920–960-1710 From the Zillow listing: The Martin K. Dahl

item.title: Lots of potential! Five acres in Alabama. $349,000
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! It could definitely use some updating and some undoing of past renovations. The house was built in the late 1800’s. It is located on five acres in Ashville, Alabama. The house features a covered front porch, balcony, carport, multiple detached buildings and baseboards. item.title: Kansas’s most expensive old house listing! On 30 acres. $2,900,000
item.description: Welcome to Kansas’s most expensive old house listing! That atrium is perfect! Would live in that room. The house was built in 1910. It is located on 30.47 acres in Shawnee, Kansas. The property features a main house, barn, pastures, horse barn, two car garage with guest apartment, in-ground pool and a large pond. There are multiple updates to the house.
